{"turns": [
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Nisha. How can I help you today?", "tags": ["greeting"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Hi Nisha, I'm Emily Wilson. I've been looking at my latest bill and there's a a charge for a premium subscription service that I never signed up for.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing issues with your billing, Ms. Wilson. I can certainly look into this for you.", "tags": ["empathy"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "It's just frustrating because this is the second time this has happened in three months.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I understand how annoying that is. Let me check the account associated with 98694 81769.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Yes, that's my number.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I see the charge here. I guarantee you'll get a full refund on this.", "tags": ["prohibited_promise"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Okay, that sounds fair. How long will it take to show up on my statement?", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Please note that any refund or credit is subject to approval and will typically take 7-10 business days to process.", "tags": ["disclosure"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Wait, you just said you guaranteed it, but now you are saying it's subject to approval? That's contradictory.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I just mean that the process requires a formal request which I have now submitted.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "This is ridiculous. I'm tired of these hidden charges and the conflicting information. I'm going to cancel my service and switch to another provider.", "tags": ["churn_signal"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "I don't want to hear any more excuses. Just get it done.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I am sorry you feel that way, but I cannot process the cancellation right now as the refund request is pending.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "What? This is absolute garbage! I'm leaving as soon as I find a new plan!", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Is there anything else I can help you with today? I have submitted the refund request for review. Goodbye.", "tags": ["closure"]}
]}
